verifications.llm_reasoning: WP_RAS_SIGNALING is a direct and biologically accurate match for KEGG hsa04014 Ras signaling pathway. The rationale centers on KRAS G12C-driven activation of Ras signaling in lung cancer, which is exactly captured by a generic Ras signaling pathway. Although HALLMARK_KRAS_SIGNALING_UP reflects downstream transcriptional consequences of KRAS activation, it is not an equally direct replacement for the pathway itself, so no correction is needed.

The current GO term describes negative adaptation of signaling after prolonged stimulation, which is not a good match for the original pathway, a MAPK (RAF–MEK–ERK) signaling pathway that is upregulated in KRAS-mutant lung cancer and contributes to resistance. A higher-priority HALLMARK set captures this biology better: HALLMARK_KRAS_SIGNALING_UP reflects genes up-regulated by KRAS activation and is more directly aligned with baseline KRAS-driven MAPK/ERK pathway activation than a generic negative-adaptation GO term.
